title: Stud Pack
tagline: Voxel asset pack in the classic stud style, with everything you need to dress a full map.
includes: Trees in 4 colors, pines, palms and dead trees
Terrain blocks, rocks, bushes and mushrooms
Chests, market stall, fountain, bench and signs
Tools, fruits, fences and small props

title: Halloween Stud Pack
tagline: 50+ spooky voxel assets in the same stud style.
includes: Haunted trees, pumpkins, tombstones and coffins
Cauldron, potions, witch hats and candles
Iron fences, pillars and market stalls

title: Stylized Trees
tagline: Leafy stylized trees with matching bushes, in a full range of colors.
includes: Trees and bushes in green, pink, cyan, orange, red and blue
